info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Payments Payments Disputes-v2-spec
info.description: The Payment Dispute Management API allows users to access and retrieve a list of payment disputes within the system. This API is essential for merchants and financial institutions seeking to manage and analyze disputes related to transactions effectively. By leveraging this API, users can identify, track, and resolve issues associated with payments disputes, ensuring a smooth resolution process. It serves as a valuable resource for customer service teams and dispute resolution specialists who need timely access to dispute data.

get.description: Fetch details related to a specific payment dispute, including associated transaction information and current status.

requestBody.description: Request body for the GET operation related to payment disputes. This body is used to specify the details required for retrieving information about a dispute on a payment.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning dispute details.

ListPaymentsPaymentsDisputesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operations related to dispute payments.

ListPaymentsPaymentsDisputesResponse_200.title: Dispute Operation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the dispute transaction.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the dispute operation.

state.description: The current state of the dispute.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the dispute in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

ListPaymentsPaymentsDisputesResponse_200.description: The response schema for the GET dispute operation, containing the status, reference, result, and audit information related to the dispute.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the dispute.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the dispute was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information about the audit trail of the dispute operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the processing of the request took before responding. A lower value indicates a more efficient processing time.
